name: door_leak_open_close
description: Two identical 7x7 roofed rooms, each with a plain wood Door (baseline 160 HP, blockLight true): one left closed, one forced open with the SetDoorOpen test step (TestMod/SetDoorOpenStep.cs) before the shot. Roofed with RoofConstructed (isThickRoof false), matching door_leak_by_type.json's own reasoning: RoofRockThick's thickRoof exception in BlocksSky (issue #129) buries the wall ring itself, not just the interior floor, which would make the wall tiles unreadable in the shot. Verifies IndoorOcclusionMath.DoorSkyLeakFor's isOpen branch — a door standing open should leak exactly like a blockLight-false door, i.e. read the same alpha door_leak_by_type.json's door_alpha_glass already pins. Runs under the Realistic preset (MinIndoorBrightness=0) for the same reason door_leak_by_type.json does: Cinematic's shared brightness floor would clamp both doors to the same alpha and hide the open/closed difference entirely.
